title: lindernia perennans
intro: Lindernia perennans, commonly known as False Frog Lip or Frog Lip, is a perennial herb belonging to the family Linderniaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in soothing skin irritations and wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lindernia perennans include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as diabetes and cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of Lindernia perennans include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, although further research is required to fully understand the extent of its bioactive properties.
